$comment: The second standard exists to prove a property of the first: that adding one is a directory and nothing else. If this file's arrival required a line of code anywhere, the design this plugin rests on would not hold, and every archetype after it would be a code change.

title.en: The project carries its second marker file

summary.en: A second fixture standard, added to demonstrate that adding one costs no code.

en: A second file this project is meant to carry is missing.
I am adding it now, then I will pick up where I left off.
fr: Un second fichier que ce projet doit porter est absent.
Je l'ajoute maintenant, puis je reprends où j'en étais.

reason.en: MARKER-TWO.md is missing from the project root, or does not contain the word MARKER. Create it with that word on a line of its own, then continue.
